question: What is the revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of the orders placed from 2026-03-01 00:00:00 to 2026-06-01 00:00:00?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE o.date >= '2026-03-01 00:00:00' AND o.date < '2026-06-01 00:00:00';

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-25 (all their orders)?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE c.birth_date <= '2026-09-25'
  AND date('2026-09-25', '-' || (
        CASE
            WHEN substr(c.birth_date, 6, 5) > '09-25' THEN '1 year'
            ELSE '0 years'
        END
    ), 'unixepoch', 'localtime') > '2026-09-25';

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-24 (all their orders)?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE
  -- Compute age on 2026-09-24
  (
    -- Age = 25 if birthday on or before 2026-09-24 and next birthday after 2026-09-24
    (
      substr(c.birth_date, 6, 5) <= '09-24' AND
      (
        substr(c.birth_date, 6, 5) < '09-24' OR
        (
          substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) < '2026' OR
          (substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) = '2026' AND substr(c.birth_date, 6, 5) <= '09-24')
        )
      )
    )
    OR
    (
      -- Age = 25 if birthday on or before 2026-09-24 and next birthday after 2026-09-24 (for those born on 2026-09-24)
      substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) = '2026' AND substr(c.birth_date, 6, 5) = '09-24'
    )
  );

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-26 (all their orders)?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE
  -- Compute age on 2026-09-26
  (
    -- Age = year difference
    CAST(SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) -
    CASE
      WHEN SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 2) > '09' THEN 1
      WHEN SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 2) = '09' AND SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 9, 2) > '26' THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) = 25
  AND SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 5) <= '09-26';

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of the orders placed by customers who were exactly 25 years old at the time of the order?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y-%m-%d', o.date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN
      CAST(strftime('%Y-%m-%d', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) + 25 * 10000 AND
      CAST(strftime('%Y-%m-%d', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) + 26 * 10000 - 1
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y-%m-%d', o.date) AS INTEGER) >=
      CAST(strftime('%Y-%m-%d', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) + 25 * 10000
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y-%m-%d', o.date) AS INTEGER) <
      CAST(strftime('%Y-%m-%d', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) + 26 * 10000;

question: What is the revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of products a, b and c only, for orders placed from 2026-01-01 00:00:00 to 2026-07-01 00:00:00 by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-25?

FROM orders o
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.product_id IN ('a','b','c')
  AND o.date >= '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AND o.date < '2026-07-01 00:00:00'
  AND c.birth_date <= '2026-09-25'
  AND (
        CASE
          WHEN substr(c.birth_date,6,2)||'-'||substr(c.birth_date,1,4) <= '09-25'
          THEN strftime('%Y', '2026-09-25') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date)
          ELSE strftime('%Y', '2026-09-25') - strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) - 1
        END
      ) = 25;
